fullText.simplified:
两个陈世美？

    那个人笑得停不下来。“你……你说什么？陈世美是你的丈夫？不可能！不可能！”
    “为什么不可能？”香儿被人这么笑，有点生气。
    “对不起啊，我不是笑你。”那个人笑了好久才停下来，“但是，那个陈世美真的不可能是你的丈夫。因为，他是公主的丈夫！三年前，他不但考了第一，还和公主结了婚，是京城里的大名人，没有人不认识他。你说，他怎么可能是你的丈夫呢？”
    公主的丈夫？香儿抱着孩子走出饭店，一边走一边想：公主的丈夫也叫陈世美？他也是三年前参加考试的吗？还是……那个陈世美就是我的丈夫呢？不！一定不是。我的丈夫怎么可能不要我们，去和公主结婚呢？
    虽然香儿觉得那个公主家的陈世美不是自己的丈夫，但是她还是决定先去公主家看看。因为现在除了去公主家，她也没有别的消息了。
    香儿一路打听，找了好久，终于找到了公主的家。红色的大门紧紧关着，门口没有人进出。香儿不敢去推门。因为，这是公主的家啊！这不是她们这样的人想进就能进的地方。于是她带着孩子在门口等着。
    过了一会儿，大门突然开了，从里面走出来一些人。有一个人走在最前面，很高兴的样子，他的后面跟着很多人。
    香儿看得清清楚楚，这个人就是她每天想着的人，这个人就是她来京城要找的人，这个人就是她的丈夫陈世美。虽然三年没有见面了，但是他还是跟原来一样。只是身上的衣服不一样了，那件红色的长衣非常漂亮。
fullText.traditional:
兩個陳世美？

    那個人笑得停不下來。“你……你說什麼？陳世美是你的丈夫？不可能！不可能！”
    “為什麼不可能？”香兒被人這麼笑，有點生氣。
    “對不起啊，我不是笑你。”那個人笑了好久才停下來，“但是，那個陳世美真的不可能是你的丈夫。因為，他是公主的丈夫！三年前，他不但考了第一，還和公主結了婚，是京城裡的大名人，沒有人不認識他。你說，他怎麼可能是你的丈夫呢？”
    公主的丈夫？香兒抱著孩子走出飯店，一邊走一邊想：公主的丈夫也叫陳世美？他也是三年前參加考試的嗎？還是……那個陳世美就是我的丈夫呢？不！一定不是。我的丈夫怎麼可能不要我們，去和公主結婚呢？
    雖然香兒覺得那個公主家的陳世美不是自己的丈夫，但是她還是決定先去公主家看看。因為現在除了去公主家，她也沒有別的消息了。
    香兒一路打聽，找了好久，終於找到了公主的家。紅色的大門緊緊關著，門口沒有人進出。香兒不敢去推門。因為，這是公主的家啊！這不是她們這樣的人想進就能進的地方。於是她帶著孩子在門口等著。
    過了一會兒，大門突然開了，從裡面走出來一些人。有一個人走在最前面，很高興的樣子，他的後面跟著很多人。
    香兒看得清清楚楚，這個人就是她每天想著的人，這個人就是她來京城要找的人，這個人就是她的丈夫陳世美。雖然三年沒有見面了，但是他還是跟原來一樣。只是身上的衣服不一樣了，那件紅色的長衣非常漂亮。

sentences.traditional: 那個人笑得停不下來。“你……你說什麼？陳世美是你的丈夫？不可能！不可能！”

sentences.simplified: “为什么不可能？”香儿被人这么笑，有点生气。
sentences.traditional: “為什麼不可能？”香兒被人這麼笑，有點生氣。

sentences.english: “Why is it impossible?” Xiang’er was a bit angry that she was being laughed at like this.

sentences.traditional: “但是，那個陳世美真的不可能是你的丈夫。因為，他是公主的丈夫！

sentences.english: “But, that Chen Shimei really couldn’t be your husband. Because he is the husband of the princess.

sentences.simplified: 三年前，他不但考了第一，还和公主结了婚，
sentences.traditional: 三年前，他不但考了第一，還和公主結了婚，
sentences.pinyin: sān nián qián tā bú dàn kǎo le dì yī hái hé gōng zhǔ jié le hūn
sentences.english: Three years ago, not only did he win first place in the examinations, he also married the princess.

sentences.traditional: 是京城裡的大名人，沒有人不認識他。你說，他怎麼可能是你的丈夫呢？”
sentences.pinyin: shì jīng chéng lǐ de dà míng rén méi yǒu rén bú rèn shi tā nǐ shuō tā zěn me kě néng shì nǐ de zhàng fu ne
sentences.english: He is very well-known in the capital; everyone knows who he is. So tell me, how could he possibly be your husband?”

sentences.simplified: 公主的丈夫？香儿抱着孩子走出饭店，
sentences.traditional: 公主的丈夫？香兒抱著孩子走出飯店，
sentences.pinyin: gōng zhǔ de zhàng fu xiāng er bào zhe hái zi zǒu chū fàn diàn
sentences.english: The princess’s husband? Xiang’er picked up her children and walked out of the restaurant.

sentences.simplified: 一边走一边想：公主的丈夫也叫陈世美？
sentences.traditional: 一邊走一邊想：公主的丈夫也叫陳世美？
sentences.pinyin: yì biān zǒu yì biān xiǎng gōng zhǔ de zhàng fu yě jiào chén shì měi
sentences.english: As she walked, she was thinking: the princess’s husband is also named Chen Shimei?

sentences.simplified: 他也是三年前参加考试的吗？还是……那个陈世美就是我的丈夫呢？
sentences.traditional: 他也是三年前參加考試的嗎？還是……那個陳世美就是我的丈夫呢？
sentences.pinyin: tā yě shì sān nián qián cān jiā kǎo shì de ma hái shi nà ge chén shì měi jiù shì wǒ de zhàng fu ne
sentences.english: Did he also participate in the examinations three years ago? Or … is that Chen Shimei actually my husband?

sentences.simplified: 不！一定不是。我的丈夫怎么可能不要我们，去和公主结婚呢？
sentences.traditional: 不！一定不是。我的丈夫怎麼可能不要我們，去和公主結婚呢？
sentences.pinyin: bù yí dìng bú shì wǒ de zhàng fu zěn me kě néng bú yào wǒ men qù hé gōng zhǔ jié hūn ne
sentences.english: No! That certainly can’t be the case. How could my husband leave us to marry the princess?

sentences.simplified: 虽然香儿觉得那个公主家的陈世美不是自己的丈夫，
sentences.traditional: 雖然香兒覺得那個公主家的陳世美不是自己的丈夫，
sentences.pinyin: suī rán xiāng er jué de nà ge gōng zhǔ jiā de chén shì měi bú shì zì jǐ de zhàng fu
sentences.english: Although Xiang’er thought that the princess’s Chen Shimei was not her husband, ..

sentences.simplified: 但是她还是决定先去公主家看看。
sentences.traditional: 但是她還是決定先去公主家看看。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì tā hái shi jué dìng xiān qù gōng zhǔ jiā kàn kan
sentences.english: .. she still decided to go to the princess’s house to take a look.

sentences.simplified: 因为现在除了去公主家，她也没有别的消息了。
sentences.traditional: 因為現在除了去公主家，她也沒有別的消息了。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi xiàn zài chú le qù gōng zhǔ jiā tā yě méi yǒu bié de xiāo xi le
sentences.english: Because right then, besides going to the princess’s house, she did not have any other information.

sentences.simplified: 香儿一路打听，找了好久，终于找到了公主的家。
sentences.traditional: 香兒一路打聽，找了好久，終於找到了公主的家。
sentences.pinyin: xiāng er yí lù dǎ ting zhǎo le hǎo jiǔ zhōng yú zhǎo dào le gōng zhǔ de jiā
sentences.english: Xiang’er made inquires the entire way and spent a very long time looking. Finally, she found the princess’s house.

sentences.simplified: 红色的大门紧紧关着，门口没有人进出。
sentences.traditional: 紅色的大門緊緊關著，門口沒有人進出。
sentences.pinyin: hóng sè de dà mén jǐn jǐn guān zhe mén kǒu méi yǒu rén jìn chū
sentences.english: The red front door was tightly shut, and no one was coming in or out of the door.

sentences.simplified: 香儿不敢去推门。因为，这是公主的家啊！
sentences.traditional: 香兒不敢去推門。因為，這是公主的家啊！
sentences.pinyin: xiāng er bù gǎn qù tuī mén yīn wèi zhè shì gōng zhǔ de jiā a
sentences.english: Xiang’er did not dare to push the door open. Because this was the princess’s house!

sentences.simplified: 这不是她们这样的人想进就能进的地方。于是她带着孩子在门口等着。
sentences.traditional: 這不是她們這樣的人想進就能進的地方。於是她帶著孩子在門口等著。
sentences.pinyin: zhè bú shì tā men zhè yàng de rén xiǎng jìn jiù néng jìn de dì fang yú shì tā dài zhe hái zi zài mén kǒu děng zhe
sentences.english: This wasn’t a place that people like her could enter freely. So, she waited at the door with her children.

sentences.simplified: 过了一会儿，大门突然开了，从里面走出来一些人。
sentences.traditional: 過了一會兒，大門突然開了，從裡面走出來一些人。
sentences.pinyin: guò le yí huì'r dà mén tū rán kāi le cóng lǐ miàn zǒu chū lái yì xiē rén
sentences.english: After a while, the door opened suddenly, and some people walked out from inside.

sentences.simplified: 有一个人走在最前面，很高兴的样子，他的后面跟着很多人。
sentences.traditional: 有一個人走在最前面，很高興的樣子，他的後面跟著很多人。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yí ge rén zǒu zài zuì qián miàn hěn gāo xìng de yàng zi tā de hòu miàn gēn zhe hěn duō rén
sentences.english: There was one person walking at the very front, looking very happy. Many people were following behind him.

sentences.simplified: 香儿看得清清楚楚，这个人就是她每天想着的人，
sentences.traditional: 香兒看得清清楚楚，這個人就是她每天想著的人，
sentences.pinyin: xiāng er kàn de qīng qīng chu chu zhè ge rén jiù shì tā měi tiān xiǎng zhe de rén
sentences.english: Xiang’er saw very clearly. This was the person she had been thinking of every day.

sentences.simplified: 这个人就是她来京城要找的人，这个人就是她的丈夫陈世美。
sentences.traditional: 這個人就是她來京城要找的人，這個人就是她的丈夫陳世美。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge rén jiù shì tā lái jīng chéng yào zhǎo de rén zhè ge rén jiù shì tā de zhàng fu chén shì měi
sentences.english: This was the person she came to the capital to find. This was her husband Chen Shimei.

sentences.simplified: 虽然三年没有见面了，但是他还是跟原来一样。
sentences.traditional: 雖然三年沒有見面了，但是他還是跟原來一樣。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán sān nián méi yǒu jiàn miàn le dàn shì tā hái shì gēn yuán lái yí yàng
sentences.english: Though it had been three years since they had seen each other, he was the same as before.

sentences.simplified: 只是身上的衣服不一样了，那件红色的长衣非常漂亮。
sentences.traditional: 只是身上的衣服不一樣了，那件紅色的長衣非常漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ shì shēn shang de yī fu bù yí yàng le nà jiàn hóng sè de cháng yī fēi cháng piào liang
sentences.english: Only his clothes were different; that red gown was very beautiful.

sentence_translations: Two Chen Shimeis?
The person could not stop laughing. “What … What did you say? Chen Shimei is your husband? Impossible! Impossible!”
“Why is it impossible?” Xiang’er was a bit angry that she was being laughed at like this.
“Oh sorry, I’m not laughing at you.” The person laughed a long time before finally stopping,
“But, that Chen Shimei really couldn’t be your husband. Because he is the husband of the princess.
Three years ago, not only did he win first place in the examinations, he also married the princess.
He is very well-known in the capital; everyone knows who he is. So tell me, how could he possibly be your husband?”
The princess’s husband? Xiang’er picked up her children and walked out of the restaurant.
As she walked, she was thinking: the princess’s husband is also named Chen Shimei?
Did he also participate in the examinations three years ago? Or … is that Chen Shimei actually my husband?
No! That certainly can’t be the case. How could my husband leave us to marry the princess?
Although Xiang’er thought that the princess’s Chen Shimei was not her husband, ..
.. she still decided to go to the princess’s house to take a look.
Because right then, besides going to the princess’s house, she did not have any other information.
Xiang’er made inquires the entire way and spent a very long time looking. Finally, she found the princess’s house.
The red front door was tightly shut, and no one was coming in or out of the door.
Xiang’er did not dare to push the door open. Because this was the princess’s house!
This wasn’t a place that people like her could enter freely. So, she waited at the door with her children.
After a while, the door opened suddenly, and some people walked out from inside.
There was one person walking at the very front, looking very happy. Many people were following behind him.
Xiang’er saw very clearly. This was the person she had been thinking of every day.
This was the person she came to the capital to find. This was her husband Chen Shimei.
Though it had been three years since they had seen each other, he was the same as before.
Only his clothes were different; that red gown was very beautiful.
